row.body: Feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. My note below says chalky water came from the feed test; the ditch smelled metallic before the noon siren sounded.
row.title: Weathered bundle note — Friday at closing

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the chalky water while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
